title: Ebyasa Omwenda eby’Okuyitibwa
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’oyimiridde wekka ng’ovuganya n’omuyaga gw’okusekererwa okumala ekiseera ekiwanvu okusinga obwakabaka bwe busituka ne bugwa, ng’oyita ekiro n’emisana ng’amatu gabikkiddwa ate ng’engoye zisimbuddwa nnyo. Mu maaso waliwo emmeeri eyazimbibwa ku ttaka amakalu n’amazzi obutafaananako n’ezo zonna ezaalabibwako. Osobola okutegeera obugumiikiriza obuli emabega w’empaka zino ez’okuyita abantu?
clues: Nayita abantu bange ekiro n’emisana, mu kyama ne mu lwatu, okusinza Allah yekka.
Abantu bange baakuba engalo mu matu ne beezinga engoye okunvaako.
Nasigala mu bantu bange okumala emyaka ebikumi mwenda mu ataano nga mbayita okulungamizibwa.
Nazimba ekibya wansi w’amaaso ga Allah n’okubikkulirwa ng’ate abantu bange banjerega ku lukalu.
Nalagirwa okutwala ku mmeeri babiri babiri aba buli ngeri n’abakkiriza ekiragiro bwe kyatuuka era oven ne ejjula.
Natunuulira amayengo nga gasituka ng’ensozi ng’amataba gabbira abo abaagaana, so nga Allah n’awonya abali mu Ssanduuko.

trial.answer: Yayita abantu bange ekiro n’emisana okumala emyaka 950

location.label: Ekintu Ekikulu

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Abantu bange baazikirizibwa empewo ey’omuzira okumala ekiro musanvu
Abaagaana babbira mu mataba amanene era abakkiriza ne balokolebwa
Abantu bange baazikirizibwa okubwatuka okw’amaanyi ku makya agamu
outcome.answer: Abaagaana babbira mu mataba amanene era abakkiriza ne balokolebwa

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
